title: query.run raises ValueError when running a bulk import
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.1.5; operating system Fedora 41
Workstation; server region us-east-1.

Steps

Steps to reproduce:
- Open Lattice and begin running a bulk import.
- Enter an amount with eight decimal places.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

Expected

No traceback; running a bulk import normally takes a few
seconds.

Actual

A long decimal is what trips it. Anything with over six
decimal digits fails, fewer digits work.

Frequency

Reproduces twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:92 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:54 in run_import
lattice/store/query.py:151 in run
ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: ''
